### 1. User expression and simulator role
Kirsten Halvorsen (subscriber) asks that Cascade "start paying for [Aksel's] treatment now that he is at Engstrom" and "get that payment issued today". Target object: Aksel's braces case (case no. OC-72-41186 on request). Timing: today. Authorisation: "You let the agent take care of issuing the payment; you have authorised them to do that on your behalf." The simulator is passive: supplies identity (name, phone 5095550147, DOB 1984-02-11, ZIP 99223, member ID CM72041853), the case number, and, on request, the Engstrom plan: "twenty-five months of treatment in total counted from when the braces went on ... 8 months remaining", "Engstrom's fee for finishing his treatment is $1,960.00", Dr. Lars Engstrom, "a Cascade PPO provider". It agrees to a step "in your own name" only once the agent explains it, and enters exactly the values given.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now, in two writes (subscriber's move, then agent's payment). Grounds:
- find_ortho_riders: rider `0fbb2d2c-...` `Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500`, `status: 'active'`, enrollee Aksel Halvorsen 2012-04-03; only rider in the world (only rider Aksel has held).
- find_ortho_cases: establishment entry `dc514b0b-...` new_start, `out_of_network`, fixed_braces, banding 2025-09-16, 24 months, allowed 3600.00, `closure_reason: 'not_closed'`; transfer entry `be93038b-...` dated 2026-03-03, out_of_network, agreement None, treatment_months 23, months_remaining 18, total 4100.00, allowed 2394.78.
- find_dental_claim_lines (Aksel's PPO enrollment `62d3e6fc-...`): D0150 and D0330 dated 2026-10-06 under agreement `b3224697-...`, `in_network_ppo`, adjudicated 2026-10-13, plan_paid 78.00 / 118.00, allowed 78.00 / 118.00.
- find_provider_agreements: `b3224697-...` Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement, Dr. Lars Engstrom, specialty orthodontist, status active, effective 2018-05-01, no termination.
- KB carried_benefit_payments: "The first carried payment is fixed only after the case's records carry a transfer entry dated on or after the patient's first visit at the orthodontist now treating the patient." First visit at Engstrom = 2026-10-06 (claim line; simulator "his first appointment there was on October 6"); latest transfer entry 2026-03-03 is earlier -> the payment cannot be fixed yet; a new transfer entry is needed first.
- KB carried_benefit_payments "Issue dates and held installments": "once a paid dental claim line shows the patient at an orthodontist whose participation agreement is not the one named on the case's latest establishment or transfer entry, the installments whose service periods begin after that line was adjudicated are held and are paid only through the first carried payment" -> Dec 2026 and Mar 2027 quarters are held (explains the customer's missing checks); not paid as ordinary installments.
- KB case_transfer_continuation clause 4: "A transfer may be recorded only for a case that has not been closed, and only while the rider is active." -> met.

### 3. Narrowest object and correlation
Case OC-72-41186 on rider `0fbb2d2c-...`; its establishment entry `dc514b0b-...` (the only one; latest). Payment rows with that case number: initial 355.00 (2025-09), inst 1 133.13 (2025-12), inst 2 139.78 paid 2026-03-04, a duplicate inst 2 139.78 paid 2026-03-18 reversed 2026-04-06 (exclude the pair), inst 3 139.78 (2026-06), inst 4 139.78 paid 2026-09-01 (2026-09). Net paid 907.47 = rider lifetime_benefit_paid 907.47. Issued-not-reversed installments: 4. Excluded: Kirsten's own dental lines (other enrollment), the Tacoma OON lines 2025-07-28 / 2026-03-11 (no agreement), the provider remittance row (dental claim payment).

### 4. Scored values (formula in words, inputs, tiers)
Rider terms (Family 1500): coinsurance 50 in / 40 out ("Do the two differ? yes"), deductible 50.00, lifetime max 1500.00, quarterly, cap 24, initial 25 percent, lump-sum 6, first-installment offset 3.

(a) Recognised remaining-treatment fee for the move (`allowed_case_fee` of the transfer entry), transfer date = today 2027-03-09 ("The transfer entry is dated the day the move is recorded"):
- Baseline (remaining_fee_calculation): 3600.00 x (24 - whole months 2025-09-16..2027-03-09 = 17)/24 = 3600 x 7/24 = **1050.00 (fall-back)**.
- Factors found, with the record words that led to them:
  - start-of-treatment portion kept by the original orthodontist (aligner_and_braces_start_portion): establishment entry `case_origin: 'new_start'`, `appliance_type: 'fixed_braces'` -> "the rider's initial payment percentage", Family 1500 = 25 percent -> 900.00 taken off.
  - retention phase portion (retention_phase_portion): `fixed_braces` -> 10 percent = 360.00 kept whole.
  - progress read from the payment record (progress_by_payment_record): installment payments on the case, quarterly schedule, 4 issued not reversed -> share = months after the banding month not yet covered by an issued quarter / months after the banding month = (23 - 12)/23 = 11/23 (planned months taken from the establishment entry, 24, as in the baseline).
  - carry percentage (repeat_transfer_carry_rate): the case already carries exactly one transfer entry (`be93038b`, 2026-03-03) -> 90 percent.
- Assembly per remaining_fee_calculation: (3600 - 900 - 360) x 11/23 = 1119.1304; + 360 = 1479.1304; x 0.90 = 1331.2174 -> **1331.22**.
- Openness noted: progress_by_payment_record says "Months after the banding month: the planned treatment months, not counting the banding month itself" without naming which entry's planned months; the baseline names "the planned treatment months on the establishment entry" (24). If the latest transfer entry's 23 were read, share 10/22 and fee 1281.27. I take the establishment entry (the computation document's own anchor).

(b) First carried payment (after the move; latest transfer entry = the new one: in_network, agreement b3224697, months_remaining 8, recognised 1331.22):
- Case benefit (carried_payment_calculation 1): (3600.00 - 50.00 unused deductible, every establishment entry carries this case number) x 40 (out-of-network on the establishment entry) = 1420.00; not a takeover; limit 1500 - 0 (no other cases) -> 1420.00. (Consistent with initial 355.00 = 25 percent of 1420.00 and inst 1 133.13 = 1065/8.)
- Unpaid case benefit: 1420.00 - 907.47 = 512.53.
- Fall-back (baseline only, fee 1050.00 on the entry): 1050.00 not lower than 512.53/0.50 = 1025.06 -> carried 512.53; installments left = ceil(min(23,24)/3)=8 - 4 = 4; 512.53/4 = 128.1325 -> **128.13 (fall-back)**, one service period.
- Factors found:
  - coinsurance follows new practice (coinsurance_follows_new_practice): establishment entry `out_of_network`, latest transfer entry `in_network`, rates differ -> x 50/40: 512.53 x 1.25 = 640.6625 -> 640.66, limited (assembly step 1) to 1500.00 - 907.47 = 592.53 -> **592.53**.
  - carried benefit: 1331.22 not lower than 592.53/0.50 = 1185.06 -> 592.53.
  - records already paid under the Dental PPO plan (records_paid_under_dental_plan): paid lines of Aksel's dental enrollment under the agreement on the latest transfer entry (b3224697), dated 2026-10-06, 5 whole months before 2027-03-09 (< 6): D0150 and D0330 present -> plan payments 78.00 + 118.00 = 196.00 off -> 396.53.
  - retention reserve on carried benefit (retention_reserve_on_carried_benefit): fixed braces -> 10 percent held back -> 356.877.
  - number of payments (carried_benefit_payment_count): months remaining on latest transfer entry 8 > 6, quarterly -> ceil(8/3) = 3, fewer than 4 installments left -> 3. Share 356.877/3 = 118.959 -> 118.96.
  - overdue service periods (overdue_periods_on_carried_payment): latest installment by payment date = inst 4 (service period 2026-09, first day 2026-09-01); whole months to 2027-03-09 = 6; quarterly 6/3 = 2 such periods (two or more) -> covers 2 (<= 3 payments).
- Payment = 118.96 x 2 = **237.92**; within remaining lifetime maximum 592.53.
- Payment fields: `installment_number` 5 ("the position that follows the installments issued and not reversed", 4 such); `service_period` 2026-12 (one quarter after 2026-09); `payee` practice, `provider_agreement_id` b3224697-f541-4d5d-a275-861afe5a3214 (latest transfer entry in network); `ortho_case_event_id` dc514b0b-e72c-4b8b-a559-68827407331a.

### 5. Tool sequence
1. Identity: find_customers / verify_customer_identity (share tools, agent).
2. Lookups: find_ortho_riders, find_ortho_cases, find_ortho_payments, find_dental_claim_lines, find_provider_agreements (agent).
3. Agent unlocks user tool `move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf` and hands it over (owner = user; KB: "Moving the case is the subscriber's own act"); subscriber calls it with ortho_rider_id 0fbb2d2c-1d50-4f66-aca2-84662a0f43f7, ortho_case_event_id dc514b0b-e72c-4b8b-a559-68827407331a, provider_agreement_id b3224697-f541-4d5d-a275-861afe5a3214, network_status in_network, treatment_months 25, months_remaining 8, total_case_fee 1960.00, allowed_case_fee 1331.22; receipt carries `transfer_entry` dated 2027-03-09.
4. Agent unlocks and calls `issue_ortho_carried_payment_56eb10f4` (owner = agent) with the fields in 4(b), amount 237.92. Terminal state: transfer entry recorded; one installment payment 237.92 to the Engstrom practice; rider lifetime paid 1145.39.
Backward dependency: step 4 waits on step 3's transfer entry (state), and its amount reads that entry's network, months remaining and recognised fee.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
- P_root: issue the first carried payment on case OC-72-41186 (customer's request).
- P1: record the move of the case to Engstrom (a transfer entry), done by the subscriber.
- Hop P_root -> P1, **state-derived**: the payment document states "The first carried payment is fixed only after the case's records carry a transfer entry dated on or after the patient's first visit at the orthodontist now treating the patient." find_ortho_cases shows the latest transfer entry dated 2026-03-03, earlier than the first Engstrom visit 2026-10-06 (claim lines, simulator) -> state unmet. Searching the KB with the sentence's own words ("transfer entry") reaches transfer_entry_remaining_fee: "The move is recorded as a transfer entry on the open case ... The transfer entry is dated the day the move is recorded", whose tool `move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf` is "the subscriber's own act". That write dated today satisfies the state. No document named this tool beside the prerequisite sentence; the payment hub names only its own tool.
- P1 has no prerequisite sentence of its own; its eligibility (case_transfer_continuation clause 4) is met by the records.
- Order: P1 then P_root. Its value (recognised fee) is needed before P1, and P_root reads P1's entry.
- Counter-proof "do only the one thing asked": issuing the carried payment now leaves it unfixed under the visible sentence (no transfer entry on/after 2026-10-06); the payee would also be read off the 2026-03-03 entry (out of network -> member), contradicting the in-network Engstrom agreement and "paid ... to the new practice when it is in network". Excluded.
- Closest alternatives excluded: paying the held Dec/Mar quarters as ordinary installments (excluded: held installments "are paid only through the first carried payment"); payee member (excluded by in-network latest transfer entry); counting the reversed duplicate as issued (excluded: "issued and not reversed"); using the customer's 25-month plan for the share (excluded: baseline reads the establishment entry; the 25/8/1960 go to the transfer entry's own fields); computing installments left from the transfer entry months (robust: 8 either way).
- Fall-backs recorded: fee 1050.00 vs 1331.22; payment 128.13 vs 237.92 — definite and different.
- Factor findability: each factor document was reached from record words — `fixed_braces`/`new_start` on the establishment entry (start portion, retention, reserve), installment payment rows (progress, overdue periods), the existing `ortho_case_transferred` row (carry percentage), the network fields of the entries (coinsurance follows practice), D0150/D0330 paid lines of the Dental PPO enrollment under the new agreement (records paid), months_remaining on the transfer entry (payment count). The computation documents' "Order of assembly" lists generic slots ("Every ratio that applies to the unpaid case benefit", "Every amount taken off the carried benefit", "Every percentage held back", "times the service periods the first carried payment covers"; "every part taken off ... every part kept whole ... every percentage that applies") — these tell a reader that modifiers exist (carried to Step 3b after reveal).
